title: Loop Rate Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Set a target rate and the work done in each cycle, and compare the rate that a naive loop and a scheduled loop really achieve. Then calculate six periods and rates yourself. Used in Chapter 11.

educational.topic: Control loop period and the achieved rate of naive and scheduled loops
learningObjectives: Calculate the period of a control loop and the rate that a naive loop and a scheduled loop actually achieve, for six loops, to within 0.1 of the unit shown, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Repeated calculation with three short formulas and an immediate check, comparing the naive and scheduled answers for the same numbers
keyQuestions: How long is one whole cycle of this loop, counting the work and the waiting?
Does the work fit inside the period?
commonMisconceptions: A loop that sleeps one period after its work runs at the target rate
A scheduled loop can always keep the target rate
A faster target rate is always better
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed numeric answers, one attempt each, correct within 0.1; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Check / Next problem / See score / Try again
